question: Find the area of a trapezium having height 7 cm and the length of parallel sides 8 cm and 12 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Height of trapezium = 7 cm

Length of parallel sides = 8 cm and 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × Height of trapezium × Sum of parallel sides

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ee8178081ebee551107b35d2133435efd8567bf9095661a392345ede1da4211.png] 

**Calculation:**

Sum of parallel sides = 8 + 12 = 20 cm

Area of trapezium = (1)/(2)times 7times 20 = 70 cm²

**∴ The area of a trapezium is 70 cm².**
